description: Record a capability these tools do not offer, for the Ads Uploader team: a missing tool, field, filter, action or level. Sends the goal, the missing capability, the tools tried and any IDs supplied, not names, emails, ad copy, tokens or other personal data. Similar requests are grouped and counted. ads_report_issue records problems with existing tools. Returns { requested: true, reference, status: 'recorded' }. Limited to 20 requests per user per hour.
name: ads_request_feature
title: Request a Missing Capability
